info.title: GetYouTubeTranscript API
info.description: YouTube transcripts, search, channel, and playlist data. Every request needs an API key, obtained from the dashboard or via the self-service /v1/signup flow. 1 credit = 1 successful request; failed and rate-limited requests are never charged. See https://getyoutubetranscript.com/docs for full human-readable docs and https://getyoutubetranscript.com/youtube-mcp-server for the MCP server.

get.description: Full transcript for one video, plus title/author/thumbnail metadata. One block of text by default; add 'timestamps=true' to also get 'segments', one {start, duration, text} per caption line (times in seconds). Same credit cost either way. Provenance: language_code is the caption track actually returned and can differ from requested_language (YouTube falls back to the track it has); caption_type is 'manual' (creator-uploaded) or 'auto' (speech recognition), null when unknown for older transcripts; cached says whether it came from our stored copy, fetched at fetched_at. Failed requests (no captions, unavailable video) are never charged.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: YouTube video URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Caption language code, e.g. 'en', 'es'.

parameters.name: timestamps
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to include 'segments': per-line {start, duration, text} timestamps in seconds, e.g. for citing a moment in the video. Off by default because it roughly doubles the response size.

parameters.name: translate
parameters.description: Language code to machine-translate the transcript into, e.g. 'es', 'de', 'zh-CN'. Each caption line is translated in place, so timestamps stay aligned. The response adds 'translated_to'; 'language_code' stays the source track. Same 1-credit cost.

200.description: Transcript retrieved. 'segments' is present only when timestamps=true.

post.summary: Agent self-signup, step 1: request an email OTP
post.description: No API key required - this is how a new caller gets one. Sends a 6-digit code good for 10 minutes.

example.message: A 6-digit code was sent to this email. It expires in 10 minutes.

post.summary: Agent self-signup, step 2: verify the OTP and mint an API key
post.description: On success, creates the account if it does not exist yet (or signs in an existing one) and returns a freshly minted API key. The raw key is shown once - store it, it cannot be retrieved again.

name.description: Optional display name for a new account. Ignored if the account already has a name.

api_key.description: The raw key, shown once. Starts with sk_live_.

400.description: Missing fields, or an invalid/expired code.

post.summary: Queue transcripts for up to 100 videos
post.description: Returns immediately with a batch_id; transcripts are fetched in the background. Poll GET /batch?id=... or pass webhook_url to be notified when it finishes. The call itself is free: 1 credit is charged per video that returns a transcript, and failed videos are never charged (e.g. 10 videos, 8 with captions = 8 credits; temporary failures are retried for you and never billed). Duplicate videos are fetched once. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries of this call safe. Webhooks POST {event, batch_id, status, total, succeeded, failed, credits_charged, results_url} with header X-GYT-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<raw body>' keyed with webhook_secret>. At most 5 unfinished batches per account; results are kept for 7 days.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a request with the same key to get the original batch back instead of a new one.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL (port 443) notified on completion.

200.description: Idempotent replay: the batch created earlier with the same Idempotency-Key.

202.description: Queued. webhook_secret is returned once, only when webhook_url was given.
